What it is: One piece of work with one owner, a due date and done criteria, and the card below says what to do now.

Who owns it: The owner delivers it, the reviewer checks it, and the ED or the ops coordinator plans it.

What must be filled: Title, Owner, Due, Objective, Expected output and Done criteria before it is offered, and a Blocked reason whenever it is blocked.

What happens automatically: Not accepted after 2 working days reminds the owner and the ED, after 5 it moves to the ops coordinator, late work is flagged on the day and to the ED 2 working days later, and Done offers the next step.
